stem:
Three friends divided three pizzas into pieces. The shaded parts of the models represent the pieces that the friends ate.

Which statement describes the fraction of a pizza that one of the friends ate?

options.label: F
options.text: Diego ate \( \frac{1}{2} \) of a pizza, because he ate the largest piece of his 2 pieces.

options.label: G
options.text: Victoria ate \( \frac{1}{3} \) of a pizza, because she ate 1 piece and had 3 equal-size pieces left over.

options.label: H
options.text: Wesley ate \( \frac{1}{2} \) of a pizza, because he ate 1 piece of his 2 equal-size pieces.

options.label: J
options.text: Victoria ate \( \frac{3}{1} \) of a pizza, because she ate 1 piece and had 3 pieces left over.

visual_elements: Three labeled circle models with shaded portions: Diego (5/8 shaded approx), Victoria (1/4 shaded), Wesley (1/2 shaded)
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires interpreting fractional parts from shaded models and matching them to conceptual fractional statements, involving reasoning beyond direct recall.
